profile.description: Ahli Bank SAOG provides commercial banking services in the Sultanate of Oman. It operates in two segments, Retail Banking; and Wholesale Banking, Treasury and Investments. The company offers current, savings, and unrestricted investment accounts, as well as fixed and term deposits; home, personal, and auto loans; debit and credit cards; overdrafts, Islamic financing, and fund transfer facilities; and bancassurance products, such as motor, personal accident, travel, home, and individual term insurance, as well as group credit life coverage. It also provides treasury, government and corporate banking, and trade finance services; and investment banking services comprising corporate finance advisory, asset management, brokerage services, and digital wealth management. In addition, the company offers internet, mobile, and SMS banking; ATM and CDM services; payment gateway and POS terminal services; and service centers and kiosk services. It serves the institutional, corporate, small and medium enterprise, and retail sectors. Ahli Bank SAOG was incorporated in 1997 and is based in Muscat, the Sultanate of Oman.
